title: Bosun Canonical Note Contract v0.1
description: Machine-readable schema contract for Bosun PKM canonical note YAML frontmatter.

created_at.description: 14-digit continuous UTC timestamp YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, or preserved raw wire string if unparseable.

updated_at.description: 14-digit continuous UTC timestamp YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, or preserved raw wire string if unparseable.

tags.description: User tags associated with the note.

source_note.description: Source container file name or path.

source_html.description: Lossless wire HTML/ENML copy extracted from source note.

en_media.description: Serialized JSON string containing ordered provenance records for inline media placeholders.

source_path.description: Original filesystem path or relative path of the source document before ingestion.

target.description: Target note identifier, file path, or URI.

title.description: Human-readable label or target note title.

properties.description: Optional arbitrary metadata attributes associated with the relationship.

relations.description: Structured graph relationships connecting this note to other entities.

related_notes.description: List of related note identifiers or titles (lightweight relation list).

original_system.description: Upstream system or repository of origin.

imported_at.description: Timestamp when this record was extracted or ingested.

converter_version.description: Version string of the conversion pipeline or adapter.

source_metadata.description: Preserved upstream properties from the source system.

provenance.description: Detailed origin and lineage metadata for auditability.

tool.description: Tool or pipeline module performing the step.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the lineage step occurred.

details.description: Parameters or operational metrics for the step.

lineage.description: Ordered transformation sequence recording note evolution across tools and pipelines.

fidelity_notes.description: Observations regarding format translation fidelity, soft degradation, or lossy conversions.

source_checksum.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g. SHA-256 or MD5) of the source note content.
